Intake question: What is the primary project type?
If Yes: Record project type; collect project description, address, and City-coordinator review item.
If No: Not applicable - select the most accurate project type.
If Unsure: Not applicable - clarify project scope before proceeding.
Notes: Project type begins the preliminary routing conversation; it is not a permit determination.

Intake question: Will the business use change, expand, relocate, or add another use?
If Yes: Add Certificate of Use (COU) to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No COU route is added from this condition; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Source / basis: COJ rules table: change in business use
Notes: Final COU requirement must be confirmed by City staff.

If Yes: Add Change of Use Building Permit to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No Change of Use Building Permit route is added from this condition; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Source / basis: COJ rules table: occupancy classification change

Intake question: Will the project include interior construction or alterations?
If Yes: Add Building Permit to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No Building Permit route is added from this condition; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: Examples include tenant build-out, partitions, exits, accessibility, and life-safety work.

Intake question: Are mechanical or HVAC systems being changed?
If Yes: Flag mechanical/HVAC review and permit requirements for City confirmation.
If No: No mechanical review flag is added; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: The current source set does not establish a universal automatic trade-permit rule.

If Yes: Flag electrical review and permit requirements for City confirmation.
If No: No electrical review flag is added; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: The current source set does not establish a universal automatic trade-permit rule.

Intake question: Is new or modified plumbing work proposed?
If Yes: Add Plumbing Permit to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No Plumbing Permit route is added from this condition; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: Final requirements must be confirmed by City staff.

Intake question: Are fire-protection systems, commercial cooking, hazardous materials, or special occupancy conditions involved?
If Yes: Flag Fire Prevention review requirements for City confirmation.
If No: No fire-review flag is added; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: Do not present this flag as a confirmed permit without an explicit routing rule.

Intake question: Will work affect parking, access, drainage, utilities, landscaping, sidewalks, or driveways?
If Yes: Add Civil review / Site-Work Permit to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No Site-Work Permit route is added from this condition; continue screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; continue screening.
Notes: Final requirements must be confirmed by City staff.

Intake question: Will work occur in the public right-of-way?
If Yes: Add Right-of-Way Permit to the preliminary permit matrix.
If No: No Right-of-Way Permit route is added from this condition; finish screening.
If Unsure: Add City-coordinator confirmation item; finish screening.
Source / basis: COJ rules table: City right-of-way work
Notes: Examples may include sidewalks, streets, or utility work within public right-of-way.

Intake question: Has a preliminary permit matrix been generated?
If Yes: Review the matrix with the COJ Permit Coordinator and relevant City staff.
If No: Continue intake until a preliminary matrix is generated.
If Unsure: Continue intake and identify unresolved questions for City coordination.
Notes: The automated output is preliminary, not City-approved.
